# Yogya Chugh

> Software engineer based in India, working with teams anywhere, who builds whole products: the mobile app, the admin tools behind it, the backend and the deploy, and keeps them cheap to run. Software Engineering Intern at Meant2Bae since September 2026, and open to freelance work.

Key facts:

- Meant2Bae (September 2026 to present): software engineering intern, paid and on-site, at a curated dating service for professionals in India. Builds the admin dashboard (React, TypeScript, Supabase) that runs the matchmaking pipeline from signup to dates; wrote 40+ PostgreSQL migrations (permission-checked admin functions, Row Level Security, a delta sync of changed rows); built automated reminder emails (pg_cron, Edge Functions), a Calendly webhook, a Google Sheets sync and the readiness quiz on meant2bae.com. https://meant2bae.com
- ScreenDemons (June 2026 to present): freelance mobile app developer building a social screen-time app end to end (React Native, Expo, Supabase). Live on the App Store, with Android in progress. Integrated Apple's Family Controls and DeviceActivity APIs to enforce screen-time limits on the device. https://screendemons.app
- Vardhman Electricals (March to June 2026): paid remote internship. Built Vardhman Saathi end to end: a React Native (Expo) Android app on Google Play, an Electron admin console, and a backend on Supabase and Cloudflare deployed by GitHub Actions. 200+ concurrent users; hosting costs ₹0 a month. https://vardhmansaathi.shop
- Burrow (formerly AnyStudio), in development: a compiler, written in Kotlin, that turns a JSON app description into one Kotlin Multiplatform project for Android, iOS and desktop. It has a web editor, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, an AI agent, and importers for Figma, Compose, SwiftUI and GraphQL. It began in Rust, with a DEX writer that built Android bytecode without the JDK.
- Webelo: the WHATWG DOM Living Standard implemented in C++, with Python bindings and a visualizer. https://github.com/YogyaChugh/Webelo
- Open source: django/django pull request #19295, merged 24 March 2025, which raises a clear TemplateSyntaxError for relative template paths with an unknown origin (ticket #36271).
- Hackathons: third place at two international hackathons in 2025 (University of Derby and Ulster University) with Pippo, a multilingual guide robot; Yogya built its companion app.
- Hack Club Summer of Making 2025: 450+ hours and four projects shipped, including Webber (a website downloader) and Timberly (a game); finished with 6,612 shells and a $1,322 grant, which bought a Gigabyte Aero X16 laptop.
- Founder and President of PIET Comp Techies, a college tech club; ran Frontend Frenzy, a website-building contest (October 2024).
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Panipat Institute of Engineering and Technology (Kurukshetra University), 2023 to 2027, CGPA 8.05/10.
- Tools: TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Python, C++, Rust, SQL; React Native, Expo, Kotlin Multiplatform, React, Electron; Node.js, Express, Hono, Django, FastAPI, Flask; PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1, Pages, Vercel; Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Gradle, Linux.

## Projects

- [Timberly](https://timberly.yogya.dev/): a lumberjack game with an online leaderboard (Python, Pygame).
- [Webber](https://webber.yogya.dev/): save websites to read offline (Python).
- [Webelo](https://webelo.yogya.dev/): the DOM, rebuilt in C++.
- [Safario](https://safario.yogya.dev/): a digital ID for tourists (React, Web3).
- [Vote Leaderboard](https://votes.yogya.dev/): voter rankings for Hack Club's Summer of Making.
- [Snake Hustle](https://snake.yogya.dev/): Nokia's Snake, taken further.
- [Western Upside-Down Island](https://island.yogya.dev/): a game where gravity runs backwards.
